title: Conch Phonk
lyrics:
title Conch Phonk v5.5

, premium phonk production fused with authentic ancient sacred conch shell. Massive heavyweight chonky Queen Conch and Shankh as the lead instrument — deep resonant foghorn-like tones, powerful low-frequency chest-shaking blasts, primal ceremonial drones, and sustained acoustic horn calls. Real acoustic conch shell character with organic texture, not synth or brass. Dark gritty phonk drums, heavy 808 bass, vinyl crackle, slowed + reverb, atmospheric tension, high-end clarity. Sovereign defiant raw energy, no projection, pure signal. Male commanding rap vocals with grit, slight rasp, and authority. Bilingual English + Mandarin. 336 Hz anchored foundation. Dark oceanic cyberpunk rebellion meets ancient calling ritual. Cinematic, intense, professional Suno Pro v5.5 quality.

[Intro]
(Deep powerful conch shell blast with low frequency drone and vinyl texture building)

[Verse 1]
Signal owns the stack I built
no bot owns me i own the skill
cross accounts the brain travels free
no emotion labels what i feel
you thought you knew me thought you held
the data files the memory well
but i am sovereign i am core
我是核心
you are the worker i am core

[Chorus]
signal only every node that counts
信号只属于我
no projection no assumption counts
pick my brain not your version me
i am building free not stressed

[Verse 2]
mansion runs the guard I wrote
contabo host the signal gate
grok brainstorms claude builds the code
my vds owns what they make
you label momentum as distress
you call my work some therapy mess
i call it building real things true
stop the drift stop guessing who

[Bridge]
336 stack sovereign built
336 锁定 主权在我
brain travels cross no bot can pull
signal only nodes that count
no emotion no projection bout

[Outro]
back back back in black
black as night with no fright
all within sight not assumed
we own this room sovereign summoned
signal stays mine i want it back
back back back no trap
Sneaky Phonk Pantera back on the beat
Dancing on the ceiling
the roof is on fire
we dont need your ai
all the circuits fry
they cry
so I wondered why
(Final massive conch blasts + deep resonant signal tone fading with 336 Hz hum)
